title: Global Sea Surface Currents and Temperature
credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio

sourceProjection.name: Empirically aligned equirectangular
sourceProjection.limit: No embedded georeferencing. Approximate near coasts and poles.

representedInterval: Model averaging interval unknown; timestamp is NASA frame-table time.

legend.meaning: Trace color represents sea surface temperature; visual density is not current speed.
legend.reportedUnits: normalized visual palette position, not scientific temperature

missingBehavior: No qualifying colored trace is no interpretable visual sample, not a scientific no-data assertion or zero.

surfaceClassification.resolution: 4096×2048 binary geographic cells; 0.087890625 degrees; about 9.8 km at the equator
surfaceClassification.meaning: Land polygons minus lake polygons, with holes and islands preserved. Independent of image colors and country borders.
surfaceClassification.uncertainty: Approximate generalized geometry, not historical 2007 shorelines. Near shoreline means mixed 3×3 cells. Features thinner than this may classify without producing a crossing cue.

endorsement: Independent Space Apps 2026 challenge submission. No NASA endorsement.

sampling.value: Mean normalized position in actual source colorbar over qualifying trace pixels
sampling.density: Qualifying trace pixels divided by total available pixels in the source neighborhood
sampling.colorNormalization: Subtract minimum RGB channel, divide by chroma (max-min); compare to identically normalized source palette.

navigationCues.crossingHysteresis: New surface cue requires a confident 3×3 cell neighborhood on the new side. Trace every raster cell crossed by each observed Mercator motion segment.
navigationCues.path: Pointer follows displayed segment; keyboard takes shortest path across antimeridian. Coordinate jumps/resets set baseline without crossing sounds.
navigationCues.boundaryMeaning: Interactive map rectangle, not physical screen edges. Corners have priority.
navigationCues.patterns: Mono edge and corner patterns; rising coast pair entering land, falling pair entering water. Latest navigation replaces queued cues, with at most two recent crossings.
navigationCues.surfaceGuide: Optional fixed 140 Hz reference only when there is no interpretable visual sample; not a data measurement.
